venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 3/20.** Garden: decent start with 3/4-top walk-ins escaping the rain; lull ~8:15; busy again ~9:30 as rain returned; one bartender supported by the team; Jada moved a lot of Material Controls, Cat's Eye and Mystery Shots; last call ~11:30, cleared by midnight. D&C: slow start with most guests asking for bar seating; floor filled from ~6:45; one server out for an emergency and Sophia covered; strong comms and menu guidance; still need to tighten water service, pre-bussing and spot checks; room cleared ~12:30. Kitchen: 10.34% of sales, mostly bar snacks; James ran a smooth shift. MOD: Kevin / Cory / Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 3/20.** Filled to capacity around 6:45; lull between 6:15 and 8:30 because 8 reservations at 8pm left no room to turn tables; peak 10:30pm; dropped off 11:45 with no waitlist. Comps $355. Team harmonized and got it done. Door: lively Friday with a lot on the books and a line of reservations; full house until ~12:45am; waitlist began 7:30, long list of twos 9-10pm, then 3s and 4s seated incl. at bar; one reservation's mobility-disability request was hidden in the reservation notes, so recommend adding a tag; welcomed Max with Zoe Davide (Speed Rack winner), Sam Fuller (EMP bartender), many birthdays. No-shows: Serim An 6 @ 8:15pm; Daisy Pineda 2 @ 10:15pm (no payment info). Kitchen: none.
